method_note: Status reflects evidence maturity, not legal certification. Documentation alone cannot establish compliance.

records.control_objective: Architecture, governance, ownership, lifecycle, and decision records are authoritative.
records.design_evidence: docs and dokumenEPelara architecture/technology candidates; audit/system-audit-report.md
records.implementation_evidence: Repository structure, CI workflows, and active backend/frontend source
records.test_evidence: No complete architecture conformance or lifecycle test evidence
records.operational_evidence: Production topology, approvals, and governance operation not supplied
records.notes: Documents and source are not sufficient to prove approved and operated architecture.

records.regulation: Perpres 95/2018; relevant local policy to be confirmed
records.control_objective: Business ownership, authoritative status, data quality, and cross-domain process consistency.
records.design_evidence: Baseline audit and domain source code
records.implementation_evidence: Partial workflow and model controls; inconsistent legacy paths remain
records.test_evidence: Frontend tests pass, critical business-flow tests are incomplete
records.operational_evidence: Owner validation, data quality reports, and process sign-off not supplied
records.notes: Partial controls exist; authoritative status and operational evidence remain incomplete.

records.regulation: Perpres 132/2022 architecture domains; internal API standard pending
records.control_objective: Versioned, validated, bounded, observable, and consistently authorized APIs.
records.design_evidence: Route/controller source and existing helper patterns
records.implementation_evidence: Some validation and authorization patterns; uneven contract/error/pagination coverage
records.test_evidence: No complete API contract/security test suite evidenced
records.operational_evidence: API SLO, rate-limit dashboards, and incident samples not supplied
records.notes: Implementation is mixed and cannot be declared compliant.

records.regulation: Perpres 95/2018; applicable electronic-system and data-protection rules to be confirmed
records.control_objective: Least privilege, tenant isolation, secret safety, secure rendering, auditability, and privacy controls.
records.implementation_evidence: Stage-3/4 targeted fixes; material legacy gaps remain
records.test_evidence: Synthetic helper tests pass; live cross-tenant/security tests not available
records.operational_evidence: SIEM, retention, incident response, key custody, and access review not supplied
records.notes: Critical and high risks remain open; release blocker.

records.regulation: Perpres 132/2022; infrastructure policy to be confirmed
records.control_objective: Resilient topology, backup, restore, capacity, recovery, and controlled deployment.
records.implementation_evidence: Backup/restore scripts exist; production topology and scheduler unknown
records.test_evidence: Self-tests exist; isolated restore drill not evidenced
records.operational_evidence: RPO/RTO, immutable/offsite copy, restore drill, and monitoring not supplied
records.notes: No production evidence; do not infer readiness from scripts.

records.domain: Layanan, dokumen, arsip, publikasi, dan aksesibilitas
records.regulation: Applicable records, signature, publication, and accessibility rules to be confirmed
records.control_objective: Official documents are authentic, classified, retained, accessible, and safely published.
records.implementation_evidence: Partial document generation and signing paths; publication/retention controls incomplete
records.test_evidence: No complete signature, accessibility, retention, and publication acceptance suite
records.operational_evidence: Retention schedule, PPID review, signature verification, and accessibility sign-off not supplied
records.notes: Applicability and operation require owner evidence.

records.control_objective: Audit trail, monitoring, alerting, evaluation, ownership, retention, and evidence integrity.
records.design_evidence: Audit services, CI workflows, and source findings
records.implementation_evidence: Partial audit services; coverage and retention uneven
records.test_evidence: Selected tests only; no complete sampling/alert validation
records.operational_evidence: Dashboards, alerts, on-call, incident and evaluation records not supplied
records.notes: Control intent exists but evidence chain is incomplete.

records.regulation: Perpres 132/2022; integration policy and e-SIGAP authority to be confirmed
records.control_objective: Versioned contracts, ownership, authorization, idempotency, failure handling, and traceability.
records.implementation_evidence: Integration scope and operational topology not fully verifiable
records.test_evidence: No complete contract, retry, dead-letter, or cross-tenant suite
records.operational_evidence: External endpoint ownership, credentials, monitoring, and failure evidence not supplied
records.notes: Blueprint must be separated from deployed implementation.
